_: 土地島. Read by the page AND by the server (server/src/game/land.js), so a price is a price and a tier is a tier: the page draws what this file says and the room charges what this file says. The island block is the hub (three buildings round a yard, coordinates relative to its own x/z like every other island's JSON; colours are decimals because island-kit.js reads them as numbers). `tiers` are the six islands a child can own, bought in order with coins only (no level): the research behind the numbers is docs/uspeak-land-research.md. `grid` is the private island's size in metres; `theme` names a look in land-world.js; `props` names what stands on it. Nothing in a tier changes how any English is judged or paid.
